question: Who among the following was an eminent physician?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bidhan Chandra Roy.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr Bidhan Chandra Roy** was an **eminent physician**, academician, freedom fighter and politician.
 
• He was the** second Chief Minister** of **West Bengal** after India gained Independence. 
 
• **National Doctor's Day** is marked in honour of **Dr BC Roy** on his birth and death anniversary, **on July 1**.
 
• He was **awarded** the **Bharat Ratna** in** 1961**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Morarji Desai was an **Indian Independence activist **and** fifth Prime Minister of India** between **1977 to 1979**.
 
• Jyoti Basu was an** Indian Politician** who served as the** former chief minister of West Bengal **between 1977 to 2000.
 
• Jyoti Basu was the **co-founders** of the **Communist Party of India**.
 
• Aruna Asaf Ali Was an Indian educator, freedom fighter, and popularly known as the '**Grand Old Lady**' of the** Independence Movement**.
 
• She is known for **hoisting the Indian flag** at the **Gowalia Tank Maidan in Mumbai** during the **Quit India Movement**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
